fact: 53.7 per cent of people aged 10 and over in Kenya owned a mobile phone in 2024, a survey figure the country reported to the International Telecommunication Union.

Kenya's 2023/24 Housing Survey, published by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics and the Communications Authority, found 53.7 per cent of individuals owning a mobile phone: 54.5 per cent of men and 52.9 per cent of women.
The Communications Authority and KNBS report from the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey says 53.7 per cent of Kenyans aged three and above own a mobile phone (urban 64.6, rural 48.6).
